verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֣ח קֹ֔רַח בֶּן־ יִצְהָ֥ר בֶּן־ קְהָ֖ת בֶּן־ לֵוִ֑י וְדָתָ֨ן וַאֲבִירָ֜ם בְּנֵ֧י אֱלִיאָ֛ב וְא֥וֹן בֶּן־ פֶּ֖לֶת בְּנֵ֥י רְאוּבֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ qō·raḥ ben- yiṣ·hār ben- qə·hāṯ ben- lê·wî wə·ḏā·ṯān wa·’ă·ḇî·rām bə·nê ’ĕ·lî·’āḇ wə·’ō·wn ben- pe·leṯ bə·nê rə·’ū·ḇên
verses.literal: Now Korah son of Izhar the son of Kohath son of Levi along with some Reubenites Dathan and Abiram sons of Eliab and On son of Peleth conducted

verses.original: וַיָּקֻ֙מוּ֙ לִפְנֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֔ה וַאֲנָשִׁ֥ים מִבְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים וּמָאתָ֑יִם נְשִׂיאֵ֥י עֵדָ֛ה קְרִאֵ֥י מוֹעֵ֖ד אַנְשֵׁי־ שֵֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qu·mū lip̄·nê mō·šeh wa·’ă·nā·šîm mib·bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ḥă·miš·šîm ū·mā·ṯā·yim nə·śî·’ê ‘ê·ḏāh qə·ri·’ê mō·w·‘êḏ ’an·šê- šêm
verses.literal: a rebellion against Moses along with 250 . . . men . . . of Israel renowned as leaders of the congregation and representatives in the assembly

verses.original: וַיִּֽקָּהֲל֞וּ עַל־ מֹשֶׁ֣ה וְעַֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֗ן וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ אֲלֵהֶם֮ רַב־ לָכֶם֒ כִּ֤י כָל־ הָֽעֵדָה֙ כֻּלָּ֣ם קְדֹשִׁ֔ים וּבְתוֹכָ֖ם יְהוָ֑ה וּמַדּ֥וּעַ תִּֽתְנַשְּׂא֖וּ עַל־ קְהַ֥ל יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qā·hă·lū ‘al- mō·šeh wə·‘al- ’a·hă·rōn way·yō·mə·rū ’ă·lê·hem raḇ- lā·ḵem kî ḵāl hā·‘ê·ḏāh kul·lām qə·ḏō·šîm ū·ḇə·ṯō·w·ḵām Yah·weh ū·mad·dū·a‘ tiṯ·naś·śə·’ū ‘al- qə·hal Yah·weh
verses.literal: They came together against Moses and Aaron and told them . . . You have taken too much upon yourselves For everyone in the entire congregation is holy and the LORD is in their midst Why then do you exalt yourselves above the assembly of the LORD

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֣ע מֹשֶׁ֔ה וַיִּפֹּ֖ל עַל־ פָּנָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·ma‘ mō·šeh way·yip·pōl ‘al- pā·nāw
verses.literal: When Moses heard this he fell facedown . . .

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֨ר אֶל־ קֹ֜רַח וְאֶֽל־ כָּל־ עֲדָתוֹ֮ לֵאמֹר֒ בֹּ֠קֶר וְיֹדַ֨ע יְהוָ֧ה אֶת־ אֲשֶׁר־ ל֛וֹ וְאֶת־ הַקָּד֖וֹשׁ וְהִקְרִ֣יב אֵלָ֑יו וְאֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִבְחַר־ בּ֖וֹ יַקְרִ֥יב אֵלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr ’el- qō·raḥ wə·’el- kāl- ‘ă·ḏā·ṯōw lê·mōr bō·qer wə·yō·ḏa‘ Yah·weh ’eṯ- ’ă·šer- lōw wə·’eṯ- haq·qā·ḏō·wōš wə·hiq·rîḇ ’ê·lāw wə·’êṯ ’ă·šer yiḇ·ḥar- bōw yaq·rîḇ ’ê·lāw
verses.literal: Then he said to Korah . . . and all his followers . . . Tomorrow morning the LORD will reveal who belongs to Him and who is holy and He will bring that person near to Himself The one He chooses He will bring near to Himself

verses.original: זֹ֖את עֲשׂ֑וּ קְחוּ־ לָכֶ֣ם מַחְתּ֔וֹת קֹ֖רַח וְכָל־ עֲדָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: zōṯ ‘ă·śū qə·ḥū- lā·ḵem maḥ·tō·wṯ qō·raḥ wə·ḵāl ‘ă·ḏā·ṯōw
verses.literal: You, Korah and all your followers are to do as follows Take censers

verses.original: וּתְנ֣וּ בָהֵ֣ן׀ אֵ֡שׁ וְשִׂימוּ֩ עֲלֵיהֶ֨ן קְטֹ֜רֶת לִפְנֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ מָחָ֔ר וְהָיָ֗ה הָאִ֛ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ יִבְחַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה ה֣וּא הַקָּד֑וֹשׁ רַב־ לָכֶ֖ם בְּנֵ֥י לֵוִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ṯə·nū ḇā·hên ’êš wə·śî·mū ‘ă·lê·hen qə·ṭō·reṯ lip̄·nê Yah·weh mā·ḥār wə·hā·yāh hā·’îš ’ă·šer- yiḇ·ḥar Yah·weh hū haq·qā·ḏō·wōš raḇ- lā·ḵem bə·nê lê·wî
verses.literal: and tomorrow you are to place fire and incense in them in the presence of the LORD Then the man the LORD chooses will be the one who is holy It is you sons of Levi who have taken too much upon yourselves

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶל־ קֹ֑רַח שִׁמְעוּ־ נָ֖א בְּנֵ֥י לֵוִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mō·šeh ’el- qō·raḥ šim·‘ū- nā bə·nê lê·wî
verses.literal: Moses also said to Korah Now listen you sons of Levi

verses.original: הַמְעַ֣ט מִכֶּ֗ם כִּֽי־ הִבְדִּיל֩ אֱלֹהֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל אֶתְכֶם֙ מֵעֲדַ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְהַקְרִ֥יב אֶתְכֶ֖ם אֵלָ֑יו לַעֲבֹ֗ד אֶת־ עֲבֹדַת֙ מִשְׁכַּ֣ן יְהוָ֔ה וְלַעֲמֹ֛ד לִפְנֵ֥י הָעֵדָ֖ה לְשָׁרְתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ham·‘aṭ mik·kem kî- hiḇ·dîl ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ·ḵem mê·‘ă·ḏaṯ yiś·rā·’êl lə·haq·rîḇ ’eṯ·ḵem ’ê·lāw la·‘ă·ḇōḏ ’eṯ- ‘ă·ḇō·ḏaṯ miš·kan Yah·weh wə·la·‘ă·mōḏ lip̄·nê hā·‘ê·ḏāh lə·šā·rə·ṯām
verses.literal: Is it not enough for you that the God of Israel has separated you from the congregation of Israel and brought you near to Himself to perform the work at the LORD’s tabernacle and to stand before the congregation to minister to them

verses.original: וַיַּקְרֵב֙ אֹֽתְךָ֔ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ אַחֶ֥יךָ בְנֵי־ לֵוִ֖י אִתָּ֑ךְ וּבִקַּשְׁתֶּ֖ם גַּם־ כְּהֻנָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaq·rêḇ ’ō·ṯə·ḵā wə·’eṯ- kāl- ’a·ḥe·ḵā ḇə·nê- lê·wî ’it·tāḵ ū·ḇiq·qaš·tem gam- kə·hun·nāh
verses.literal: He has brought you near - you and all your fellow Levites . . . but you are seeking the priesthood as well

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן אַתָּה֙ וְכָל־ עֲדָ֣תְךָ֔ הַנֹּעָדִ֖ים עַל־ יְהוָ֑ה וְאַהֲרֹ֣ן מַה־ ה֔וּא כִּ֥י תִלּוֹנוּ עָלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên ’at·tāh wə·ḵāl ‘ă·ḏā·ṯə·ḵā han·nō·‘ā·ḏîm ‘al- Yah·weh wə·’a·hă·rōn mah- hū kî ṯil·lō·nū ‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: Therefore it is you and all your followers who have conspired against the LORD As for Aaron who is he that you should grumble against him

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח מֹשֶׁ֔ה לִקְרֹ֛א לְדָתָ֥ן וְלַאֲבִירָ֖ם בְּנֵ֣י אֱלִיאָ֑ב וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ לֹ֥א נַעֲלֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ mō·šeh liq·rō lə·ḏā·ṯān wə·la·’ă·ḇî·rām bə·nê ’ĕ·lî·’āḇ way·yō·mə·rū lō na·‘ă·leh
verses.literal: Then Moses summoned . . . Dathan and Abiram the sons of Eliab but they said We will not come

verses.original: הַמְעַ֗ט כִּ֤י הֶֽעֱלִיתָ֙נוּ֙ מֵאֶ֨רֶץ זָבַ֤ת חָלָב֙ וּדְבַ֔שׁ לַהֲמִיתֵ֖נוּ בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר כִּֽי־ תִשְׂתָּרֵ֥ר עָלֵ֖ינוּ גַּם־ הִשְׂתָּרֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ham·‘aṭ kî he·‘ĕ·lî·ṯā·nū mê·’e·reṣ zā·ḇaṯ ḥā·lāḇ ū·ḏə·ḇaš la·hă·mî·ṯê·nū bam·miḏ·bār kî- ṯiś·tā·rêr ‘ā·lê·nū gam- hiś·tā·rêr
verses.literal: Is it not enough that you have brought us up out of a land flowing with milk and honey to kill us in the wilderness . . . Must you also appoint yourself as ruler . . . over us

verses.original: אַ֡ף לֹ֣א אֶל־ אֶרֶץ֩ זָבַ֨ת חָלָ֤ב וּדְבַשׁ֙ הֲבִ֣יאֹתָ֔נוּ וַתִּ֨תֶּן־ לָ֔נוּ נַחֲלַ֖ת שָׂדֶ֣ה וָכָ֑רֶם הַעֵינֵ֞י הָאֲנָשִׁ֥ים הָהֵ֛ם תְּנַקֵּ֖ר לֹ֥א נַעֲלֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ap̄ lō ’el- ’e·reṣ zā·ḇaṯ ḥā·lāḇ ū·ḏə·ḇaš hă·ḇî·’ō·ṯā·nū wat·tit·ten- lā·nū na·ḥă·laṯ śā·ḏeh wā·ḵā·rem ha·‘ê·nê hā·’ă·nā·šîm hā·hêm tə·naq·qêr lō na·‘ă·leh
verses.literal: Moreover you have not brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey or given us an inheritance of fields and vineyards Will you gouge out the eyes of these men No, we will not come

verses.original: וַיִּ֤חַר לְמֹשֶׁה֙ מְאֹ֔ד וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־ יְהוָ֔ה אַל־ תֵּ֖פֶן אֶל־ מִנְחָתָ֑ם לֹ֠א חֲמ֨וֹר אֶחָ֤ד מֵהֶם֙ נָשָׂ֔אתִי וְלֹ֥א הֲרֵעֹ֖תִי אֶת־ אַחַ֥ד מֵהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·ḥar lə·mō·šeh mə·’ōḏ way·yō·mer ’el- Yah·weh ’al- tê·p̄en ’el- min·ḥā·ṯām lō ḥă·mō·wr ’e·ḥāḏ mê·hem nā·śā·ṯî wə·lō hă·rê·‘ō·ṯî ’eṯ- ’a·ḥaḏ mê·hem
verses.literal: Then Moses became very angry and said to the LORD Do not regard . . . their offering I have not taken . . . one donkey from them or mistreated a single one of them

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל־ קֹ֔רַח אַתָּה֙ וְכָל־ עֲדָ֣תְךָ֔ הֱי֖וּ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה אַתָּ֥ה וָהֵ֛ם וְאַהֲרֹ֖ן מָחָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mō·šeh ’el- qō·raḥ ’at·tāh wə·ḵāl ‘ă·ḏā·ṯə·ḵā hĕ·yū lip̄·nê Yah·weh ’at·tāh wā·hêm wə·’a·hă·rōn mā·ḥār
verses.literal: And Moses said to Korah You and all your followers are to appear before the LORD tomorrow you and they and Aaron

verses.original: וּקְח֣וּ׀ אִ֣ישׁ מַחְתָּת֗וֹ וּנְתַתֶּ֤ם עֲלֵיהֶם֙ קְטֹ֔רֶת וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֞ם לִפְנֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ אִ֣ישׁ מַחְתָּת֔וֹ חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וּמָאתַ֖יִם מַחְתֹּ֑ת וְאַתָּ֥ה וְאַהֲרֹ֖ן אִ֥ישׁ מַחְתָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·qə·ḥū ’îš maḥ·tā·ṯōw ū·nə·ṯat·tem ‘ă·lê·hem qə·ṭō·reṯ wə·hiq·raḇ·tem lip̄·nê Yah·weh ’îš maḥ·tā·ṯōw ḥă·miš·šîm ū·mā·ṯa·yim maḥ·tōṯ wə·’at·tāh wə·’a·hă·rōn ’îš maḥ·tā·ṯōw
verses.literal: Each man is to take his censer place incense in it and present it before the LORD 250 . . . censers You and Aaron . . . are to present your censers as well

verses.original: וַיִּקְח֞וּ אִ֣ישׁ מַחְתָּת֗וֹ וַיִּתְּנ֤וּ עֲלֵיהֶם֙ אֵ֔שׁ וַיָּשִׂ֥ימוּ עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם קְטֹ֑רֶת וַֽיַּעַמְד֗וּ פֶּ֛תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד וּמֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאַהֲרֹֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·ḥū ’îš maḥ·tā·ṯōw way·yit·tə·nū ‘ă·lê·hem ’êš way·yā·śî·mū ‘ă·lê·hem qə·ṭō·reṯ way·ya·‘am·ḏū pe·ṯaḥ ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ ū·mō·šeh wə·’a·hă·rōn
verses.literal: So each man took his censer put fire - and incense in it and stood with Moses and Aaron at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting

verses.original: וַיַּקְהֵ֨ל עֲלֵיהֶ֥ם קֹ֙רַח֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ הָ֣עֵדָ֔ה אֶל־ פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וַיֵּרָ֥א כְבוֹד־ יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ כָּל־ הָעֵדָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yaq·hêl ‘ă·lê·hem qō·raḥ ’eṯ- kāl- hā·‘ê·ḏāh ’el- pe·ṯaḥ ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ way·yê·rā ḵə·ḇō·wḏ- Yah·weh ’el- kāl- hā·‘ê·ḏāh
verses.literal: When Korah had gathered his whole assembly against them at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting the glory of the LORD appeared to the whole congregation

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh wə·’el- ’a·hă·rōn lê·mōr
verses.literal: And the LORD said to Moses . . . and Aaron . . .

verses.original: הִבָּ֣דְל֔וּ מִתּ֖וֹךְ הָעֵדָ֣ה הַזֹּ֑את וַאַכַלֶּ֥ה אֹתָ֖ם כְּרָֽגַע׃
verses.transliteration: hib·bā·ḏə·lū mit·tō·wḵ hā·‘ê·ḏāh haz·zōṯ wa·ʾa·ḵal·lɛh ’ō·ṯām kə·rā·ḡa‘
verses.literal: Separate yourselves from this congregation so that I may consume them in an instant

verses.original: וַיִּפְּל֤וּ עַל־ פְּנֵיהֶם֙ וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ אֵ֕ל אֱלֹהֵ֥י הָרוּחֹ֖ת לְכָל־ בָּשָׂ֑ר הָאִ֤ישׁ אֶחָד֙ יֶחֱטָ֔א וְעַ֥ל כָּל־ הָעֵדָ֖ה תִּקְצֹֽף׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yip·pə·lū ‘al- pə·nê·hem way·yō·mə·rū ’êl ’ĕ·lō·hê hā·rū·ḥōṯ lə·ḵāl bā·śār hā·’îš ’e·ḥāḏ ye·ḥĕ·ṭā wə·‘al kāl- hā·‘ê·ḏāh tiq·ṣōp̄
verses.literal: But Moses and Aaron fell facedown . . . and said O God the God of the spirits of all flesh when one man sins will You be angry with the whole congregation

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֥ר אֶל־ הָעֵדָ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר הֵֽעָלוּ֙ מִסָּבִ֔יב לְמִשְׁכַּן־ קֹ֖רַח דָּתָ֥ן וַאֲבִירָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: dab·bêr ’el- hā·‘ê·ḏāh lê·mōr hê·‘ā·lū mis·sā·ḇîḇ lə·miš·kan- qō·raḥ dā·ṯān wa·’ă·ḇî·rām
verses.literal: Tell . . . the congregation . . . to move away from the dwellings of Korah Dathan and Abiram

verses.original: וַיָּ֣קָם מֹשֶׁ֔ה וַיֵּ֖לֶךְ אֶל־ דָּתָ֣ן וַאֲבִירָ֑ם וַיֵּלְכ֥וּ אַחֲרָ֖יו זִקְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qām mō·šeh way·yê·leḵ ’el- dā·ṯān wa·’ă·ḇî·rām way·yê·lə·ḵū ’a·ḥă·rāw ziq·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: So Moses got up and went to Dathan and Abiram and the elders of Israel followed him

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֨ר אֶל־ הָעֵדָ֜ה לֵאמֹ֗ר ס֣וּרוּ נָ֡א מֵעַל֩ אָהֳלֵ֨י הָאֲנָשִׁ֤ים הָֽרְשָׁעִים֙ הָאֵ֔לֶּה וְאַֽל־ תִּגְּע֖וּ בְּכָל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם פֶּן־ תִּסָּפ֖וּ בְּכָל־ חַטֹּאתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr ’el- hā·‘ê·ḏāh lê·mōr sū·rū nā mê·‘al ’ā·ho·lê hā·’ă·nā·šîm hā·rə·šā·‘îm hā·’êl·leh wə·’al- tig·gə·‘ū bə·ḵāl ’ă·šer lā·hem pen- tis·sā·p̄ū bə·ḵāl ḥaṭ·ṭō·ṯām
verses.literal: And he warned . . . the congregation . . . Move away now from the tents of these wicked men Do not touch anything that belongs to them or you will be swept away because of all their sins

verses.original: וַיֵּעָל֗וּ מֵעַ֧ל מִשְׁכַּן־ קֹ֛רֶח דָּתָ֥ן וַאֲבִירָ֖ם מִסָּבִ֑יב וְדָתָ֨ן וַאֲבִירָ֜ם יָצְא֣וּ נִצָּבִ֗ים פֶּ֚תַח אָֽהֳלֵיהֶ֔ם וּנְשֵׁיהֶ֥ם וּבְנֵיהֶ֖ם וְטַפָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·‘ā·lū mê·‘al miš·kan- qō·rɛḥ dā·ṯān wa·’ă·ḇî·rām mis·sā·ḇîḇ wə·ḏā·ṯān wa·’ă·ḇî·rām yā·ṣə·’ū niṣ·ṣā·ḇîm pe·ṯaḥ ’ā·ho·lê·hem ū·nə·šê·hem ū·ḇə·nê·hem wə·ṭap·pām
verses.literal: So they moved away from the dwellings of Korah Dathan and Abiram Meanwhile Dathan and Abiram had come out and stood at the entrances to their tents with their wives and children and infants

verses.original: וַיֹּאמֶר֮ מֹשֶׁה֒ בְּזֹאת֙ תֵּֽדְע֔וּן כִּֽי־ יְהוָ֣ה שְׁלָחַ֔נִי לַעֲשׂ֕וֹת אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הַֽמַּעֲשִׂ֖ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה כִּי־ לֹ֖א מִלִּבִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mō·šeh bə·zōṯ tê·ḏə·‘ūn kî- Yah·weh šə·lā·ḥa·nî la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ’êṯ kāl- ham·ma·‘ă·śîm hā·’êl·leh kî- lō mil·lib·bî
verses.literal: Then Moses said This is how you will know that the LORD has sent me to do all these things for it was not my own doing

verses.original: אִם־ כְּמ֤וֹת כָּל־ הָֽאָדָם֙ יְמֻת֣וּן אֵ֔לֶּה וּפְקֻדַּת֙ כָּל־ הָ֣אָדָ֔ם יִפָּקֵ֖ד עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם לֹ֥א יְהוָ֖ה שְׁלָחָֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- kə·mō·wṯ kāl- hā·’ā·ḏām yə·mu·ṯūn ’êl·leh ū·p̄ə·qud·daṯ kāl- hā·’ā·ḏām yip·pā·qêḏ ‘ă·lê·hem lō Yah·weh šə·lā·ḥā·nî
verses.literal: If these men die a natural death - or if they suffer . . . the fate of all men then the LORD has not sent me

verses.original: וְאִם־ בְּרִיאָ֞ה יִבְרָ֣א יְהוָ֗ה וּפָצְתָ֨ה הָאֲדָמָ֤ה אֶת־ פִּ֙יהָ֙ וּבָלְעָ֤ה אֹתָם֙ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָהֶ֔ם וְיָרְד֥וּ חַיִּ֖ים שְׁאֹ֑לָה וִֽידַעְתֶּ֕ם כִּ֧י נִֽאֲצ֛וּ הָאֲנָשִׁ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה אֶת־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- bə·rî·’āh yiḇ·rā Yah·weh ū·p̄ā·ṣə·ṯāh hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ’eṯ- pî·hā ū·ḇā·lə·‘āh ’ō·ṯām wə·’eṯ- kāl- ’ă·šer lā·hem wə·yā·rə·ḏū ḥay·yîm šə·’ō·lāh wî·ḏa‘·tem kî ni·’ă·ṣū hā·’ă·nā·šîm hā·’êl·leh ’eṯ- Yah·weh
verses.literal: But if the LORD brings about something unprecedented and the earth opens its mouth and swallows them and all that belongs to them so that they go down alive into Sheol then you will know that these men have treated the LORD with contempt

verses.original: וַיְהִי֙ כְּכַלֹּת֔וֹ לְדַבֵּ֕ר אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה וַתִּבָּקַ֥ע הָאֲדָמָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּחְתֵּיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kə·ḵal·lō·ṯōw lə·ḏab·bêr ’êṯ kāl- had·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh wat·tib·bā·qa‘ hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ’ă·šer taḥ·tê·hem
verses.literal: As soon as Moses had finished saying all this . . . the ground beneath them split open

verses.original: וַתִּפְתַּ֤ח הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ אֶת־ פִּ֔יהָ וַתִּבְלַ֥ע אֹתָ֖ם וְאֶת־ בָּתֵּיהֶ֑ם וְאֵ֤ת כָּל־ הָאָדָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְקֹ֔רַח וְאֵ֖ת כָּל־ הָרֲכֽוּשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tip̄·taḥ hā·’ā·reṣ ’eṯ- pî·hā wat·tiḇ·la‘ ’ō·ṯām wə·’eṯ- bāt·tê·hem wə·’êṯ kāl- hā·’ā·ḏām ’ă·šer lə·qō·raḥ wə·’êṯ kāl- hā·ră·ḵūš
verses.literal: and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them and their households all Korah’s men and all their possessions

verses.original: וַיֵּ֨רְד֜וּ הֵ֣ם וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר לָהֶ֛ם חַיִּ֖ים שְׁאֹ֑לָה וַתְּכַ֤ס עֲלֵיהֶם֙ הָאָ֔רֶץ וַיֹּאבְד֖וּ מִתּ֥וֹךְ הַקָּהָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·rə·ḏū hêm wə·ḵāl ’ă·šer lā·hem ḥay·yîm šə·’ō·lāh wat·tə·ḵas ‘ă·lê·hem hā·’ā·reṣ way·yō·ḇə·ḏū mit·tō·wḵ haq·qā·hāl
verses.literal: They went down alive into Sheol with all they owned The earth closed over them and they vanished from the assembly

verses.original: וְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֛ר סְבִיבֹתֵיהֶ֖ם נָ֣סוּ לְקֹלָ֑ם כִּ֣י אָֽמְר֔וּ פֶּן־ תִּבְלָעֵ֖נוּ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer sə·ḇî·ḇō·ṯê·hem nā·sū lə·qō·lām kî ’ā·mə·rū pen- tiḇ·lā·‘ê·nū hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: At their cries all the people of Israel who were around them fled saying The earth may swallow us too

verses.original: וְאֵ֥שׁ יָצְאָ֖ה מֵאֵ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וַתֹּ֗אכַל אֵ֣ת הַחֲמִשִּׁ֤ים וּמָאתַ֙יִם֙ אִ֔ישׁ מַקְרִיבֵ֖י הַקְּטֹֽרֶת׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·’êš yā·ṣə·’āh mê·’êṯ Yah·weh wat·tō·ḵal ’êṯ ha·ḥă·miš·šîm ū·mā·ṯa·yim ’îš maq·rî·ḇê haq·qə·ṭō·reṯ
verses.literal: And fire came forth from the LORD and consumed the 250 . . . men who were offering the incense

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .

verses.original: אֱמֹ֨ר אֶל־ אֶלְעָזָ֜ר בֶּן־ אַהֲרֹ֣ן הַכֹּהֵ֗ן וְיָרֵ֤ם אֶת־ הַמַּחְתֹּת֙ מִבֵּ֣ין הַשְּׂרֵפָ֔ה וְאֶת־ הָאֵ֖שׁ זְרֵה־ הָ֑לְאָה כִּ֖י קָדֵֽשׁוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·mōr ’el- ’el·‘ā·zār ben- ’a·hă·rōn hak·kō·hên wə·yā·rêm ’eṯ- ham·maḥ·tōṯ mib·bên haś·śə·rê·p̄āh wə·’eṯ- hā·’êš zə·rêh- hā·lə·’āh kî qā·ḏê·šū
verses.literal: Tell . . . Eleazar son of Aaron the priest to remove the censers from the flames and to scatter the coals far away because the censers are holy

verses.original: אֵ֡ת מַחְתּוֹת֩ הַֽחַטָּאִ֨ים הָאֵ֜לֶּה בְּנַפְשֹׁתָ֗ם וְעָשׂ֨וּ אֹתָ֜ם רִקֻּעֵ֤י פַחִים֙ צִפּ֣וּי לַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ כִּֽי־ הִקְרִיבֻ֥ם לִפְנֵֽי־ יְהוָ֖ה וַיִּקְדָּ֑שׁוּ וְיִֽהְי֥וּ לְא֖וֹת לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ’êṯ maḥ·tō·wṯ ha·ḥaṭ·ṭā·’îm hā·’êl·leh bə·nap̄·šō·ṯām wə·‘ā·śū ’ō·ṯām riq·qu·‘ê p̄a·ḥîm ṣip·pui lam·miz·bê·aḥ kî- hiq·rî·ḇum lip̄·nê- Yah·weh way·yiq·dā·šū wə·yih·yū lə·’ō·wṯ liḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: As for the censers of those who sinned at the cost of their own lives hammer them into sheets to overlay the altar for these were presented before the LORD and so have become holy They will serve as a sign to the Israelites . . .

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֞ח אֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֗ן אֵ֚ת מַחְתּ֣וֹת הַנְּחֹ֔שֶׁת אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִקְרִ֖יבוּ הַשְּׂרֻפִ֑ים וַֽיְרַקְּע֖וּם צִפּ֥וּי לַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ ’el·‘ā·zār hak·kō·hên ’êṯ maḥ·tō·wṯ han·nə·ḥō·šeṯ ’ă·šer hiq·rî·ḇū haś·śə·ru·p̄îm way·raq·qə·‘ūm ṣip·pui lam·miz·bê·aḥ
verses.literal: So Eleazar the priest took the bronze censers brought by those who had been burned up and he had them hammered out to overlay the altar

verses.original: זִכָּר֞וֹן לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לְ֠מַעַן אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא־ יִקְרַ֜ב אִ֣ישׁ זָ֗ר אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹ֣א מִזֶּ֤רַע אַהֲרֹן֙ ה֔וּא לְהַקְטִ֥יר קְטֹ֖רֶת לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְלֹֽא־ יִהְיֶ֤ה כְקֹ֙רַח֙ וְכַ֣עֲדָת֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה בְּיַד־ מֹשֶׁ֖ה לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: zik·kā·rō·wn liḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl lə·ma·‘an ’ă·šer lō- yiq·raḇ ’îš zār ’ă·šer lō miz·ze·ra‘ ’a·hă·rōn hū lə·haq·ṭîr qə·ṭō·reṯ lip̄·nê Yah·weh wə·lō- yih·yeh ḵə·qō·raḥ wə·ḵa·‘ă·ḏā·ṯōw ka·’ă·šer dib·ber Yah·weh bə·yaḏ- mō·šeh lōw
verses.literal: just as the LORD . . . commanded him through Moses This was to be a reminder to the Israelites . . . that no outsider . . . who is not a descendant of Aaron should approach to offer incense before the LORD lest he become like Korah and his followers

verses.original: וַיִּלֹּ֜נוּ כָּל־ עֲדַ֤ת בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מִֽמָּחֳרָ֔ת עַל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְעַֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵאמֹ֑ר אַתֶּ֥ם הֲמִתֶּ֖ם אֶת־ עַ֥ם יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yil·lō·nū kāl- ‘ă·ḏaṯ bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl mim·mā·ḥo·rāṯ ‘al- mō·šeh wə·‘al- ’a·hă·rōn lê·mōr ’at·tem hă·mit·tem ’eṯ- ‘am Yah·weh
verses.literal: The next day the whole congregation . . . of Israel grumbled against Moses . . . and Aaron saying You have killed the LORD’s people

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י בְּהִקָּהֵ֤ל הָֽעֵדָה֙ עַל־ מֹשֶׁ֣ה וְעַֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֔ן וַיִּפְנוּ֙ אֶל־ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וְהִנֵּ֥ה כִסָּ֖הוּ הֶעָנָ֑ן וַיֵּרָ֖א כְּב֥וֹד יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî bə·hiq·qā·hêl hā·‘ê·ḏāh ‘al- mō·šeh wə·‘al- ’a·hă·rōn way·yip̄·nū ’el- ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ wə·hin·nêh ḵis·sā·hū he·‘ā·nān way·yê·rā kə·ḇō·wḏ Yah·weh
verses.literal: But when the congregation gathered against them Moses . . . and Aaron turned toward the Tent of Meeting . . . and suddenly the cloud covered it and the glory of the LORD appeared

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֤א מֹשֶׁה֙ וְאַהֲרֹ֔ן אֶל־ פְּנֵ֖י אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō mō·šeh wə·’a·hă·rōn ’el- pə·nê ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ
verses.literal: Then Moses and Aaron went to the front of the Tent of Meeting

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: and the LORD said to Moses . . .

verses.original: הֵרֹ֗מּוּ מִתּוֹךְ֙ הָעֵדָ֣ה הַזֹּ֔את וַאֲכַלֶּ֥ה אֹתָ֖ם כְּרָ֑גַע וַֽיִּפְּל֖וּ עַל־ פְּנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hê·rōm·mū mit·tō·wḵ hā·‘ê·ḏāh haz·zōṯ wa·’ă·ḵal·leh ’ō·ṯām kə·rā·ḡa‘ way·yip·pə·lū ‘al- pə·nê·hem
verses.literal: Get away from this congregation so that I may consume them in an instant And Moses and Aaron fell facedown . . .

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֗ן קַ֣ח אֶת־ הַ֠מַּחְתָּה וְתֶן־ עָלֶ֨יהָ אֵ֜שׁ מֵעַ֤ל הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ וְשִׂ֣ים קְטֹ֔רֶת וְהוֹלֵ֧ךְ מְהֵרָ֛ה אֶל־ הָעֵדָ֖ה וְכַפֵּ֣ר עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם כִּֽי־ יָצָ֥א הַקֶּ֛צֶף מִלִּפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה הֵחֵ֥ל הַנָּֽגֶף׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mō·šeh ’el- ’a·hă·rōn qaḥ ’eṯ- ham·maḥ·tāh wə·ṯen- ‘ā·le·hā ’êš mê·‘al ham·miz·bê·aḥ wə·śîm qə·ṭō·reṯ wə·hō·w·lêḵ mə·hê·rāh ’el- hā·‘ê·ḏāh wə·ḵap·pêr ‘ă·lê·hem kî- yā·ṣā haq·qe·ṣep̄ mil·lip̄·nê Yah·weh hê·ḥêl han·nā·ḡep̄
verses.literal: Moses said to Aaron Take your censer place fire from the altar . . . in it and add incense Go quickly to the congregation and make atonement for them because wrath has come out from the LORD the plague has begun

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח אַהֲרֹ֜ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר׀ דִּבֶּ֣ר מֹשֶׁ֗ה וַיָּ֙רָץ֙ אֶל־ תּ֣וֹך הַקָּהָ֔ל וְהִנֵּ֛ה הֵחֵ֥ל הַנֶּ֖גֶף בָּעָ֑ם וַיִּתֵּן֙ אֶֽת־ הַקְּטֹ֔רֶת וַיְכַפֵּ֖ר עַל־ הָעָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ ’a·hă·rōn ka·’ă·šer dib·ber mō·šeh way·yā·rāṣ ’el- tōḵ haq·qā·hāl wə·hin·nêh hê·ḥêl han·ne·ḡep̄ bā·‘ām way·yit·tên ’eṯ- haq·qə·ṭō·reṯ way·ḵap·pêr ‘al- hā·‘ām
verses.literal: So Aaron took the censer as Moses had ordered and ran into the midst of the assembly . . . And seeing that the plague had begun among the people . . . he offered the incense and made atonement for the people

verses.original: וַיַּעֲמֹ֥ד בֵּֽין־ הַמֵּתִ֖ים וּבֵ֣ין הַֽחַיִּ֑ים וַתֵּעָצַ֖ר הַמַּגֵּפָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·mōḏ bên- ham·mê·ṯîm ū·ḇên ha·ḥay·yîm wat·tê·‘ā·ṣar ham·mag·gê·p̄āh
verses.literal: He stood between . . . the living and the dead and the plague was halted

verses.original: וַיִּהְי֗וּ הַמֵּתִים֙ בַּמַּגֵּפָ֔ה אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֛ר אֶ֖לֶף וּשְׁבַ֣ע מֵא֑וֹת מִלְּבַ֥ד הַמֵּתִ֖ים עַל־ דְּבַר־ קֹֽרַח׃
verses.transliteration: way·yih·yū ham·mê·ṯîm bam·mag·gê·p̄āh ’ar·bā·‘āh ‘ā·śār ’e·lep̄ ū·šə·ḇa‘ mê·’ō·wṯ mil·lə·ḇaḏ ham·mê·ṯîm ‘al- də·ḇar- qō·raḥ
verses.literal: But those who died from the plague numbered 14,700 . . . . . . . . . . . . in addition to those who had died on account of Korah

verses.original: וַיָּ֤שָׁב אַהֲרֹן֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶל־ פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְהַמַּגֵּפָ֖ה נֶעֱצָֽרָה׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yā·šāḇ ’a·hă·rōn ’el- mō·šeh ’el- pe·ṯaḥ ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ wə·ham·mag·gê·p̄āh ne·‘ĕ·ṣā·rāh
verses.literal: Then Aaron returned to Moses at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting since the plague had been halted
